论文以对称非负矩阵分解为模型基础，并在其框架下提出改进方法。

annotations.exact_quote: by seeking low-rank representation for the tensor synthesized by the pairwise constraint matrix and a similarity matrix

annotations.exact_quote: We finally refine the similarity matrix by the strengthened pairwise constraints. We repeat the above steps to continuously boost the similarity matrix and pairwise constraint matrix
annotations.reason_zh: 成对约束被强化并迭代用于更新相似矩阵与约束矩阵，体现成对约束的传播/扩展，而非仅直接使用已知约束。
